title: FreedomKits
description: A simple kit system that gives shulkers with predefined items. All commands are OP-only.
body:
# 📦 **FreedomKits**

**FreedomKits** is a simple plugin that adds a kit system using shulkers.

## ✨ **Features**
📦 _/kit_ command for getting kits
🎁 Each kit is given as a shulker box containing items inside
## 🔐 **Permissions**

All commands are **OP-only** by default.

## 🧩 **Usage**

```
/kit <name>
```


You will receive a shulker box with the selected kit items.
